title: Probability as a weighted sum
statement: For a circuit $C$ on $n$ Boolean inputs and a probability mass function $\mu$ on Boolean assignments, its probability under $\mu$ equals $\sum_x \mathbf{1}_{\{C(x)=\mathrm{true}\}}\,\mu(x)$, where the indicator is $1$ when $C(x)$ is true and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $\mu$ is a probability mass function on Boolean assignments to those inputs
